notes: Worklist: the ten pending_instrument_runs entries with spase_record null (MAG, MWR, GRAV, JADE, JEDI, Waves, UVS, JIRAM, JunoCam, SRU), which are the same ten names as instrument_coverage.missing_from_spase. Each name appears once in each list, so no entries needed merging. MAG's components (FGM and ASC) come from instrument_coverage.notes and from John L. Jørgensen's instrument_roles entry (instrument MAG, component ASC). Neither component is a worklist entry of its own.

No pending_instrument_runs entry already has a record. The one existing record, spase://SMWG/Instrument/Juno/Ephemeris (InstrumentType Platform), has no pending run; the finder notes it is a virtual Platform instrument with no instrument-level roles.

CDPP-AMDA records: the finder's instrument_coverage.notes says the CNES records do not count because they point to spase://CNES/Observatory/CDPP-AMDA/Juno rather than spase://SMWG/Observatory/Juno. The skill's rule is the reverse: a hit under any authority is a skip, and the check covers 'the same mission registered as an Observatory under another authority with a different path'. spase://CNES/Observatory/CDPP-AMDA/Juno is that case: ResourceName Juno, PI Scott Bolton, StartDate 2011-08-05, region Jupiter. So JADE, JEDI and Waves are skipped as existing, and so is MAG, whose fluxgate magnetometer is CDPP-AMDA's FGM record. The Observatory run's instrument_coverage is therefore wrong for these four, and the finder's rule should be corrected.

Neither the registrar script nor the author mapper can see the CNES records. Both match records on this Observatory's path (Instrument/Juno/...) and on ObservatoryID, so a record filed at CNES/Instrument/CDPP-AMDA/Juno/... with ObservatoryID spase://CNES/Observatory/CDPP-AMDA/Juno passes the script's duplicate guard. These four skips are the only thing preventing duplicates. The mapper will also not list the four CNES records, even as REPORT. So the Observatory run's instrument_roles for JADE (6), JEDI (5), Waves (6) and MAG (3) reach no input or report unless a curator passes them on to CNES's curators.

SHM: the Observatory record's Description lists 'The Scalar Helium Magnetometer, SHM'. It is not on the worklist, and the finder judged it an error copied from NSSDC (no other source names it). No record is planned. The same Description lists FGM and ASC as separate instruments; the finder merged them as MAG.

Naming: the only sibling under spase://SMWG/Instrument/Juno/ is Ephemeris ('Juno Positions'), which does not follow a '<Mission> <Full name> (<Acronym>)' pattern. ResourceNames are therefore the full names as each team writes them, and the acronyms are alternate names.
InstrumentType, InvestigationName and Description are left unfilled, per the skill: the script writes Unspecified and empty elements.

Registry sources: the site source (Heliophysics Instruments API plus spase-metadata.org) ran. The GitHub source could not: gh is not installed and GITHUB_TOKEN is unset, and its refresh aborts on hpde/CFA, which returns HTTP 409 (an empty repository) to the git/trees call. registry.py retries 409 and then raises, instead of treating it as a repository with no Instrument folder.
